name: Awesome Deep RL
one_line: Curated general deep-RL resource list: libraries, benchmark results, environments (incl. Meta-World, PyBullet), competitions, a 1947-2021 timeline, books, tutorials and blogs.

name: Awesome Learning for Manipulation
one_line: Curated paper list on learning-based manipulation: VLAs (including an RL fine-tuning subsection), video-action models, visuomotor policies, world models, benchmarks, simulators and industry tech reports.

name: Awesome Real World RL
one_line: Curated list of papers, books, talks, courses, datasets and libraries for making RL work in real-world settings: sim-to-real, offline RL, imitation learning, meta-RL.

name: Awesome Test-Time Robot Learning
one_line: Curated list and taxonomy of deployment-stage robot policy improvement in six lines: RL post-training, policy steering, test-time adaptation/training, in-context learning, test-time scaling, policy self-improvement.

name: Awesome-Embodied-AI (wadeKeith)
one_line: Community-maintained embodied-AI list of 430+ resources: surveys, VLA models, embodied RL, code-as-policy, in-context learning, humanoids, safety, simulators, datasets and toolkits.

name: Awesome-Flow-RL-Papers
one_line: Curated table of 20+ papers/projects training flow-matching models and policies with RL, tagged by domain (robotics/CV/NLP), online/offline, on/off-policy, and pretrain vs fine-tune.

name: awesome-model-based-RL (OpenDILab)
one_line: Curated, continually updated list of model-based RL papers by venue (classics through ICLR/ICML 2026), with key insights, environments, a taxonomy, tutorials and codebases.

name: awesome-physical-ai
one_line: Curated paper list on Physical AI: VLAs, world models, action representations, and learning paradigms including an RL fine-tuning section (VLA-RL, FLaRe, CO-RFT).

name: Awesome-Real2Sim2Real
one_line: Curated list of 2024-2026 papers on sim-to-real, real-to-sim and Real2Sim2Real closed-loop transfer (RL sim2real, domain randomization, Gaussian-splatting pipelines, benchmarks) for robotics and embodied AI.

name: Awesome-RL-VLA: Awesome RL-VLA for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Companion list to the TechRxiv survey on RL for VLA manipulation models; organizes papers into offline, online, offline+online and test-time RL-VLA, plus base models, benchmarks and tools.

name: Awesome-Robotics-Diffusion
one_line: Curated list of robot-learning papers using diffusion models (diffusion as policy, as synthesizer, benchmarks, applications) for manipulation, navigation and planning; companion to an IJCV 2026 survey.

name: awesome-vla-wam
one_line: Curated list of Vision-Language-Action and World Action Model research, including RL-for-VLA sections, latent action models, human action pretraining, surveys, datasets and benchmarks.

name: Awesome-WAM (World Action Models)
one_line: Curated World Action Model papers (cascaded/joint WAMs, world models for VLA imitation, RL and evaluation, data, benchmarks) with reading blogs and leaderboard; accompanies survey arXiv 2605.12090.

name: Awesome-World-Model-for-Robotics-Policy
one_line: Curated list accompanying the survey "World Model for Robot Learning" (arXiv 2605.00080): world models as policies, as simulators for RL and policy evaluation, video backbones, benchmarks, datasets.

name: Embodied_AI_Paper_List (HCPLab-SYSU)
org: Sun Yat-sen University HCP Lab; Pengcheng Laboratory
one_line: Paper list for the embodied-AI survey "Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World" (arXiv 2407.06886): simulators, perception, interaction, agents/VLAs, sim-to-real, datasets.

name: Active Real-World Factor-Based Evaluation for Generalist Robot Policies
one_line: Frames real-robot policy evaluation as sequential experimental design with a probabilistic surrogate over task factors; roughly 20-40% more efficient than random testing across 3 real tasks.

name: ArmnetBench v0.1: Parallel Real-World Evaluation of Manipulation Policies on a Low-Cost Arm Farm
one_line: Parallel real-world benchmark on a fleet of low-cost SO-101 arms: 7 policies, 12 tasks, 2,518 rollouts plus 600 demos (3,118 episodes) labeled success/suboptimal/failure.

name: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
one_line: Simulation benchmark of 1,000 long-horizon everyday household activities across 50 scenes and 9,000+ annotated objects, built on OmniGibson with rigid, deformable and liquid physics.

name: BiGym: A Demo-Driven Mobile Bi-Manual Manipulation Benchmark
one_line: MuJoCo benchmark of 40 mobile bi-manual home manipulation tasks with human-collected demonstrations, proprioceptive plus RGB/depth observations from 3 cameras, for demo-driven IL and RL.

name: CALVIN: A Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks
one_line: Open-source simulated benchmark for long-horizon, language-conditioned manipulation from onboard sensors, with D/ABC/ABCD training splits and MTLC / LH-MTLC evaluation; RA-L 2022 Best Paper.

name: Critical Interval MSE: Toward Reliable Offline Validation for Robot Manipulation Policies
one_line: Offline validation metric computing action MSE only on task-critical segments with action alignment; Spearman -0.87 with real rollout success vs -0.61 for raw MSE across checkpoints.

name: FailBench: How Reliable are VLMs at Judging Robot Task Success?
one_line: Benchmark of 2,197 manipulation attempts from 14 sources (12 real, 2 sim) for VLM success detection; best model reaches 0.77 balanced accuracy, under 0.60 on contact-heavy assembly.

name: Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration
one_line: Audits seven simulated VLA benchmarks (RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, VLABench...), finding 22 bugs and 4 design limitations; fixing them reorders acceleration-method rankings, sometimes moving the baseline from last to first.

name: Gymnasium-Robotics
one_line: A collection of robotics simulation environments for reinforcement learning, maintained by the Farama Foundation.

name: H2RBench: A Real-to-Sim Benchmark for Evaluating Human-to-Robot Transfer
one_line: Real-to-sim benchmark with four manipulation tasks for evaluating human-video-to-robot transfer methods; simulated results predict real-robot performance with Pearson r = 0.89.

name: How to Better Train VLAs: Lessons Learned From the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026
one_line: Lessons from three REAL-I Challenge teams on a dual-arm humanoid under a fixed demo budget: data curation, staged adaptation preserving priors, action-space design. Imitation-only, no RL.

name: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
one_line: Evaluates six VLA/world-action models over 3 seeds on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Para: clean scores differ 1.58 pts, robustness 14.62, paraphrase sensitivity 31.08.

name: Isaac Lab-Arena
one_line: Isaac Lab extension providing a composable, scalable system for building diverse simulation environments (embodiments, objects, scenes) and evaluating robot learning policies.

name: LIBERO-Plus: In-depth Robustness Analysis of Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: 10,030 perturbed LIBERO tasks across 7 factors; VLAs fall from 95% to below 30% under modest camera or initial-state shifts and largely ignore language instructions.

name: LIBERO-PRO: Towards Robust and Fair Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models Beyond Memorization
one_line: Extends LIBERO with perturbations to objects, initial states, instructions and environments; VLAs scoring over 90% on standard LIBERO drop to 0.0%, exposing memorization.

name: LIBERO-RECOVER: Beyond Task Success Towards Failure Recovery in Robotic Manipulation Models
one_line: LIBERO-based benchmark of 1,000+ failure scenarios across four recovery levels (action retry, action adaptation, object-state, environmental recovery) testing whether VLAs recover from drops, collisions, unintended motions.

name: Memory, Benchmark & Robots: A Benchmark for Solving Complex Tasks with Reinforcement Learning (MIKASA-Robo)
one_line: Memory-intensive tabletop manipulation benchmark on ManiSkill for RL and VLAs; grown from 32 to 90 tasks with 22,500 PPO/motion-planning oracle trajectories (ICLR 2026).

name: Meta-World
one_line: Open-source benchmark of 50 continuous-control robotic manipulation tasks for multi-task (MT1/MT10/MT50) and meta-RL (ML1/ML10/ML45), Gymnasium API; repo cites Meta-World+ (arXiv 2505.11289).

name: OGBench
one_line: A benchmark for offline goal-conditioned RL and offline RL.

name: REVERSAL-BENCH: A Reversibility Axis and Reset Oracle for Measuring the Reset-Free RL Cliff
one_line: Benchmark with a reversibility parameter rho in [0,1] and reset oracle over eight manipulation tasks in five physics engines; reset-free agents hit a cliff, episodic agents keep learning.

name: RLBench
one_line: A large-scale robot learning benchmark and learning environment.

name: RoboArena
one_line: Distributed, scalable benchmark for generalist robot policies: code for serving policies from remote servers and evaluating them in simulation; points to openpi for DROID VLA training.

name: RoboArena: Distributed Real-World Evaluation of Generalist Robot Policies
org: UC Berkeley; CMU; UPenn; et al.
one_line: Crowd-sourced double-blind pairwise real-world evaluation on DROID across seven institutions; preference aggregation ranks seven generalist policies from 600+ episodes, more accurately than centralized evaluation.

name: RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots
one_line: Simulation benchmark of 365 everyday household mobile-manipulation tasks across 2,500 kitchen environments with 2,200+ hours of human and synthetic demonstrations for training and evaluating generalist policies (ICLR 2026).

name: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Generalist Robots
one_line: Kitchen simulation framework on robosuite; RoboCasa365 (v1.0, Feb 2026) offers 365 tasks, 2,500+ scenes, 600+ hours human demos, 1,600+ hours robot data, and a public leaderboard.

name: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots
one_line: Kitchen simulation framework with 150+ object categories, thousands of generative-AI-assisted 3D assets and 100 evaluation tasks, plus human demos and automated trajectory generation for generalist robot policies.

name: RoboChallenge: Large-scale Real-robot Evaluation of Embodied Policies
one_line: Online real-robot evaluation platform for embodied policies, especially VLAs, addressing scalability and reproducibility; introduces the Table30 benchmark and evaluates state-of-the-art VLA models.

name: RoboChrono: A Real Robot Benchmark for Streaming Task Understanding
one_line: Real-robot benchmark (39 scenarios, 34,713 instances, 7 tasks) testing 18 VLMs on streaming action/progress understanding; best model hits 98.3% frame matching but 68.3% frame ordering.

name: Robocurve: Inspect Robots (open-source real-robot evaluation framework)
one_line: YC S); shipped open-source Inspect Robots framework v1 and tested one frontier robotics model.

name: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
one_line: Sim-and-real benchmark: 42 Isaac Sim tasks plus 18 real tasks via cloud-based RealEval, testing generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon execution; 30 policies integrated with public leaderboard.

name: robomimic: A Modular Framework for Robot Learning from Demonstration
one_line: Modular framework for robot learning from demonstration (; widely used imitation-learning codebase and benchmark base for policy fine-tuning work.

name: RoboPhys-3D: A Comprehensive Embodied World Model Evaluation via 3D Reconstruction
one_line: 3D-reconstruction-grounded benchmark for embodied world models on RoboTwin 2.0: 50 tasks, 5,000 episodes, 25,000 multi-view videos, 50 metrics; score correlates with human evaluation at r=0.9761.

name: RoboRecover: Benchmarking Robot Policy Recovery under Execution Deviations
one_line: Benchmark of 2,000 off-nominal intermediate-state scenarios (1,000 each on RoboTwin and LIBERO, 800/200 train/test); shows initial-state success does not determine recovery performance.

name: Robotics benchmarking: where we are, and what comes next
one_line: Survey of robot evaluation from YCB to RoboCasa365 (43% single skills, 4.4% novel combinations); argues high-fidelity real-to-sim scene reconstruction can find policy weaknesses and guide data collection.

name: RoboTwin 2.0: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark with Strong Domain Randomization for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
one_line: 50-task bimanual sim benchmark and MLLM-driven data generator with 5-axis domain randomization (731 objects, 147 categories); synthetic data gives 367% relative VLA gain; ICML 2026.

name: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
one_line: MetaSim abstraction unifying Isaac, MuJoCo, SAPIEN, Genesis and more, porting LIBERO, ManiSkill, CALVIN, SimplerEnv tasks with RL (FastTD3, CleanRL) and IL (ACT, Diffusion Policy) baselines; RSS 2025.

name: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
one_line: Benchmark of 2,390 real-robot trajectories with progress labels and 21,673 verified paraphrases; shows VLM reward models shift progress scores and flip success/failure under instruction rewording.

name: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
one_line: Benchmark for embodied world models on synchronized head and wrist views: 500 episodes, 50 bimanual tasks, 19 metrics on cross-view consistency, physics, 3D coherence, combined into a TWB-Score.

name: Uncovering and Mitigating Positional Blind Spots in Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: Grid-based statistical testing finds workspace regions where VLAs fail (0.678 avg F1 across five policies); targeted LoRA fine-tuning on those regions cuts failure rates 40-85%.

name: vla-evaluation-harness
one_line: Unified harness (pip install vla-eval) decoupling VLA model servers from Dockerized sim benchmarks; batched parallel eval runs 2,000 LIBERO episodes in 18 min on one H100 (47x throughput).

name: VLABench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Robotics Manipulation with Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
one_line: Simulation benchmark for VLAs, embodied agents and VLMs on language-conditioned long-horizon manipulation, with six evaluation tracks and a fine-tuning dataset of 10 primitive tasks; ICCV 2025.

name: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
one_line: Extends the WorldArena embodied world-model benchmark to visuotactile modalities, RL policy optimization inside world models (beyond planning), and both simulated and real robot platforms.

name: X2Real: an eXtensive simulation benchmark for real-world generalist policies
one_line: Calibrated simulation benchmark for generalist manipulation policies: 44 hierarchical tasks across 10 capability dimensions, ~300 hours of annotated trajectories, 0.84 linear correlation between sim and real-robot results.

name: XPolicyLab: A Unified Standard and Open Ecosystem for Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment
one_line: Unified observation/action/trajectory schemas and client/server adapters integrating 42 policies; cuts policy-environment integration from O(NM) to O(N+M), 5+ hours to 2, across RoboTwin, RoboDojo and real robots.

name: A Course in Reinforcement Learning (2nd Edition)
one_line: Bertsekas's free ASU course textbook: approximate-DP view of RL covering rollout, multistep search, MPC and policy gradients; 2nd edition adds transformer/LLM connections.

name: Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning (Csaba Szepesvari)
one_line: Concise Morgan & Claypool monograph on core RL algorithms (TD, Monte Carlo, Q-learning, actor-critic, function approximation, exploration); about 34 algorithms, 22 with pseudocode; free PDF from the author.

name: Deep Reinforcement Learning: From First Principles to Reasoning Models
one_line: Book-length text from dynamic programming and TD learning through DQN, policy gradients, PPO, SAC, MuZero, offline and multi-agent RL to reasoning models, with implementation and evaluation guidance.

name: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (Second Edition)
org: Richard S. Sutton; Andrew G. Barto; MIT Press
one_line: Sutton and Barto's RL textbook (2nd ed., MIT Press 2018); the authors' page hosts the full PDF, errata, code, solutions and teaching slides. General RL background.

name: Reinforcement Learning: An Overview
one_line: Kevin Murphy's book-length overview of deep RL: value-based, policy-based, model-based, multi-agent, offline and hierarchical RL, intrinsic rewards, RL+LLMs with code examples; v5 posted Dec 2025.

name: Statistical and Algorithmic Foundations of Reinforcement Learning
one_line: INFORMS 2025 tutorial on non-asymptotic sample complexity and lower bounds for model-based, value-based and policy-optimization RL across simulator, online, offline, robust and human-feedback settings.

name: Brax
one_line: Differentiable JAX physics engine with PPO, SAC, ARS, ES and APG trainers on accelerators; since 0.13.0 only brax/training is maintained, environments via MuJoCo Playground/MJX..

name: CleanRL
one_line: High-quality single-file implementations of deep RL algorithms with research-friendly features (PPO, DQN, C51, DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPG).

name: CORL: Clean Offline Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Single-file implementations of offline and offline-to-online RL algorithms: AWAC, BC, CQL, DT, EDAC, IQL, SAC-N, TD3+BC, LB-SAC, SPOT, Cal-QL, ReBRAC (repo now archived).

name: d3rlpy
one_line: An offline deep reinforcement learning library.

name: EnvPool
one_line: C++-based high-performance parallel (vectorized) environment execution engine for general RL environments.

name: Gymnasium
one_line: Standard API for single-agent reinforcement learning environments, with popular reference environments and utilities (formerly OpenAI Gym).

name: jaxrl
one_line: Clean JAX/Flax implementations of continuous-action deep RL: SAC, AWAC, DrQ, DDPG with clipped double-Q, REDQ, and behavioral cloning; superseded by jaxrl2.

name: LeanRL
one_line: CleanRL-derived single-file PyTorch RL scripts optimized for speed using torch.compile and CUDA graphs.

name: PureJaxRL
one_line: End-to-end JAX RL (PPO) with environment and training jitted together; ~10x faster than CleanRL single-run, over 1000x when vmapping many agents on GPU.

name: RL Baselines3 Zoo
one_line: Training framework for Stable Baselines3 RL agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.

name: rl_games
one_line: Open-source RL implementations library; created January 2019.

name: RSL-RL
one_line: Lightweight GPU-accelerated robot learning library with PPO and student-teacher distillation, multi-GPU training; used by Isaac Lab, Legged Gym, mjlab and MuJoCo Playground (paper arXiv:2509.10771).

name: Sample Factory
one_line: High-throughput synchronous and asynchronous reinforcement learning library.

name: skrl
one_line: Modular RL library in PyTorch, JAX and NVIDIA Warp with support for Gymnasium/Gym, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, MuJoCo Playground and other environments.

name: Stable-Baselines3
one_line: PyTorch version of Stable Baselines: reliable implementations of reinforcement learning algorithms in one library.

name: Tianshou
one_line: An elegant PyTorch deep reinforcement learning library from Tsinghua's thu-ml group).

name: TorchRL
one_line: A modular, primitive-first, python-first PyTorch library for reinforcement learning.

name: ACT: Action Chunking with Transformers
one_line: Original Action Chunking with Transformers implementation; companion code to the ALOHA paper arXiv 2304.13705.

name: AgileX PiPER SDK
one_line: Official AgileX code for controlling the PiPER robotic arm.

name: ALOHA: A Low-cost Open-source Hardware System for Bimanual Teleoperation
one_line: ROS 1 teleoperation and data-collection code plus hardware assembly guide for the ALOHA bimanual system (four arms, four cameras); pairs with the ACT repo for imitation learning.

name: Ax: Adaptive Experimentation Platform
one_line: Meta's open-source adaptive experimentation platform; general black-box optimization tooling.

name: BoTorch: Bayesian Optimization in PyTorch
one_line: Meta's PyTorch library for Bayesian optimization.

name: cmaes
one_line: Python library for the CMA Evolution Strategy, a black-box optimizer.

name: COST-HIL: Cost-Aware Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Dexterous Manipulation
one_line: HIL-SERL variant with cost-aware intervention scheduling, TD/reliability-weighted replay and gripper-switch penalty; README self-reports 99.9% vs 80.7% success, 80% fewer interventions. No paper; unreviewed.

name: Dexbotic: Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Toolbox
one_line: PyTorch VLA toolbox supporting multiple mainstream VLA policies under one environment setup, experiment-script-centric, with stronger pretrained models.

name: EvoJAX: Hardware-Accelerated Neuroevolution
one_line: JAX neuroevolution toolkit running evolution algorithms, policy networks and vectorized tasks in parallel on GPUs/TPUs; experiments finish in minutes instead of hours. Repo now archived.

name: evosax: Evolution Strategies in JAX
one_line: JAX library of 30+ evolution strategies (CMA-ES, OpenAI-ES, Differential Evolution, PSO, Diffusion Evolution) with an ask-eval-tell API compatible with jit, vmap and lax.scan on GPU/TPU.

name: EvoTorch
one_line: Advanced evolutionary computation library built directly on PyTorch, created at NNAISENSE.

name: EvoX
one_line: Distributed GPU-accelerated framework for evolutionary computation with a comprehensive library of evolutionary algorithms and benchmark problems.

name: EXPO: Expressive Policy Optimization
one_line: Official JAX code for "EXPO: Stable Reinforcement Learning with Expressive Policies" (arXiv 2507.07986), built on jaxrl and RLPD; D4RL Antmaze and Adroit offline-to-online scripts. Known list has this id under a blog title.

name: GELLO: A General, Low-Cost, and Intuitive Teleoperation Framework for Robot Manipulators
one_line: MIT-licensed software for GELLO kinematic-replica teleoperation leaders built from 3D-printed parts and cheap motors; supports Franka, UR, xArm and YAM, with bimanual and demonstration data collection.

name: Interbotix ALOHA
one_line: Trossen Robotics' fork of the Mobile ALOHA repo: ROS 2 teleoperation, dataset collection and evaluation tools for Stationary and Mobile ALOHA kits; pairs with Interbotix ACT/ACT++ forks.

name: Isaac GR00T
one_line: Apache-2.0 code and weights for GR00T N1.7, an open cross-embodiment humanoid VLA (Cosmos-Reason2 VLM + diffusion transformer head), with fine-tuning, inference and evaluation scripts; N1.5/N1.6 on branches.

name: Koch v1.1 low-cost robot arm
one_line: Version 1.1 of Alexander Koch's low-cost robot arm with small design changes; open hardware repo.

name: LeRobot
one_line: Hugging Face robot learning library: datasets, ACT/diffusion/pi0/SmolVLA policies, SO-101 and other low-cost hardware, a modular RL stack with HIL-SERL, reward models (TOPReward, Robometer, SARM) and DAgger-style data collection.

name: Low-cost robot arm
one_line: Open-source low-cost leader/follower robot arm hardware design repo by Alexander Koch; no repo description given.

name: Model-Based RSL RL (rsl_rl_rwm): Robotic World Model and Uncertainty-Aware Robotic World Model code
one_line: Fork of RSL RL adding model-based RL algorithms for Robotic World Model (arXiv 2501.10100) and Uncertainty-Aware RWM for offline MBRL on real robots (arXiv 2504.16680).

name: Nevergrad
one_line: Python toolbox for performing gradient-free optimization).

name: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
one_line: Open-source transformer diffusion generalist policy (27M/93M params) pretrained on 800k robot trajectories, with head-only or full fine-tuning to new robots on small datasets.

name: openpi
one_line: Official Apache-2.0 repo with pi0, pi0-FAST and pi0.5 base checkpoints (10k+ hours robot data) plus JAX/PyTorch fine-tuning and inference code; ALOHA and DROID examples.

name: Optuna
one_line: A hyperparameter optimization framework.

name: pyAgxArm
one_line: Official AgileX Python SDK for Piper and Nero arms plus AgxGripper and Revo2 end effectors: CAN communication, status reading, motion and end-effector control. LGPL-3.0.

name: pycma
one_line: Python implementation of CMA-ES (Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy) for black-box optimization.

name: real-time-chunking-kinetix: Simulated experiments for "Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies"
one_line: Official Kinetix sim code for Real-Time Chunking and training-time RTC: trains experts, generates data, trains flow policies, and evaluates across inference delays and execution horizons on 12 levels.

name: resfit-pytorch (unofficial ResFiT implementation, WIP)
one_line: Unofficial work-in-progress PyTorch implementation of ResFiT (arXiv 2509.19301): residual off-policy RL for fine-tuning behavior cloning policies. README marks it WIP.

name: SO-ARM100 (Standard Open Arm 100 / SO-101)
one_line: Open-source 3D-printable low-cost leader/follower robot arm hardware ("Standard Open Arm 100"), Apache-2.0, widely used with LeRobot.

name: StarVLA: A Lego-like Codebase for Vision-Language-Action Model Developing
one_line: Modular VLA codebase with swappable VLM/world-model backbones and action heads, co-training recipes, and unified eval on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa-GR1, BEHAVIOR-1K (arXiv 2604.05014).

name: Universal Manipulation Interface
one_line: Official UMI code: robot-free handheld-gripper demo collection, SLAM video processing, dataset generation, and diffusion-policy training with UR5 deployment and a cup-arrangement checkpoint.

name: vla-rlt: RL Tokens for open-source VLAs (SmolVLA on SO-101)
one_line: Unofficial RL Token reimplementation: frozen SmolVLA, bottleneck RL-token encoder, SAC actor adding regularized delta actions; offline pretrain then online SAC on SO-101, runs on Apple Silicon. No own results.

name: VLAb: Your Laboratory for Pretraining VLAs
one_line: LeRobot-derived library for pretraining VLAs; official SmolVLA reproduction kit with multi-dataset sampling and multi-GPU/SLURM training. Fine-tuning and inference are deferred to LeRobot.

name: X-VLA: Soft-Prompted Transformer as a Scalable Cross-Embodiment Vision-Language-Action Model (official code)
one_line: Official X-VLA-0.9B code (ICLR 2026): embodiment-specific soft prompts on a unified Transformer for cross-embodiment VLA; natively in LeRobot; won AgiBot World Challenge at IROS 2025.

name: XLeRobot: Practical Dual-Arm Mobile Home Robot for $660
one_line: Open-source (Apache-2.0) low-cost dual-arm mobile home robot hardware and software, advertised at $660.

name: 16-831: Introduction to Robot Learning (CMU, Spring 2026)
one_line: CMU Spring 2026 course by David Held covering deep learning for robotics, model-based/model-free, on-/off-policy and offline RL, behavior cloning, DAgger, inverse RL, and generative models.

name: CS 185/285: Deep Reinforcement Learning (UC Berkeley, Sergey Levine)
one_line: Levine's Spring 2026 deep RL course: imitation learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, Q-learning, model-based, offline and LLM RL; 25 lectures, five homeworks, Fall 2023 lecture recordings on YouTube.

name: CS 224R: Deep Reinforcement Learning (Stanford, Chelsea Finn)
one_line: Stanford's Spring 2026 deep RL course: imitation, policy gradients, Q-learning, offline RL, reward learning, model-based RL, sim-to-real, and RL for VLAs; Spring 2025 lectures on YouTube.

name: CS234: Reinforcement Learning (Stanford, Winter 2026)
one_line: Emma Brunskill's introductory RL course: tabular MDP planning, policy evaluation, Q-learning with function approximation, policy search, exploration, deep RL and RL from human feedback; Python assignments.

name: DeepMind x UCL RL Lecture Series (2021)
one_line: 13-part DeepMind x UCL reinforcement learning video lecture series on the Google DeepMind YouTube channel; lecture 1 is "Introduction to Reinforcement Learning".

name: Hugging Face Deep Reinforcement Learning Course
one_line: Free hands-on deep RL course (theory plus practice) using Stable Baselines3, RL Baselines3 Zoo, Sample Factory and CleanRL; now low-maintenance, leaderboard and Unit 7 no longer functional.

name: Spinning Up in Deep RL
one_line: OpenAI's educational deep RL resource: intro to RL concepts, curated key-paper list, exercises, and reference implementations of VPG, TRPO, PPO, DDPG, TD3, SAC; now in maintenance mode.

name: UCL Course on RL (David Silver) - Advanced Topics 2015 (COMPM050/COMPGI13): Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Classic 10-lecture RL course with slides and YouTube videos: MDPs, dynamic programming, model-free prediction/control, function approximation, policy gradients, learning plus planning, exploration, games; includes Easy21 assignment.

name: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
one_line: Open dataset of 1M+ real-robot trajectories over 217 tasks plus GO-1 latent-action generalist policy; pretraining gives ~30% average gain over Open X-Embodiment, 32% over RDT.

name: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
one_line: 76k demonstration trajectories (350 hours) across 564 scenes and 84 tasks, collected by 50 people over 12 months; training with it improves policy performance and generalization.

name: Galaxea Open-World Dataset and G0 Dual-System VLA Model
one_line: Open-world robot dataset from real living/working environments plus G0, a dual-system VLM-planner + VLA-executor trained via cross-embodiment pretraining, single-embodiment pretraining, then task-specific post-training.

name: Minari
one_line: Standard format for offline reinforcement learning datasets, with popular reference datasets and related utilities (Farama Foundation).

name: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
one_line: Unified dataset from 22 robots across 21 institutions (527 skills, 160,266 tasks); RT-X models trained on it show positive cross-embodiment transfer. Common pretraining corpus for generalist policies.

name: REBOOT: From Failure to Recovery - A Dataset and Benchmark for Precision Assembly
one_line: 2,160 demonstrations over 18 precision-assembly tasks pairing failures with expert recovery trajectories; five-phase completion metrics benchmark transformer, diffusion and pi0-FAST policies beyond binary success.

name: RoboMIND 2.0: A Multimodal, Bimanual Mobile Manipulation Dataset for Generalizable Embodied Intelligence
one_line: 310K+ dual-arm trajectories, 739 tasks, six embodiments, plus tactile, mobile and digital-twin sim data; includes MIND-2 dual-system VLM/VLA optimized with offline RL.

name: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation (ABC)
one_line: Open-source BC stack: ABC-130K (3,500 h, 130K+ episodes, 195 tasks) plus 400 h sim-teleop for co-training, DiT/VLA checkpoints, simulation evaluation, and real-robot DAgger checkpoints.

name: Genesis
one_line: Open-source (Apache-2.0) simulation platform for general-purpose robotics and embodied AI learning.

name: gym-hil
one_line: Hugging Face's human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning environment suite; the repo describes itself as a "Human in the loop Reinforcement Learning suite".

name: Isaac Lab
one_line: Unified open-source (BSD-3) robot-learning framework with multi-physics and multi-renderer support; v3.0.0-EA released 2026-09-16.

name: Isaac Sim
one_line: Open-source NVIDIA Omniverse application for developing, simulating, and testing AI-driven robots in realistic virtual environments.

name: legged_gym: Isaac Gym Environments for Legged Robots
one_line: Isaac Gym environments for training ANYmal and other legged robots on rough terrain with PPO (rsl_rl), including actuator network and domain randomization for sim-to-real; now migrated to Isaac Lab.

name: mjlab: A Lightweight Framework for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
one_line: Isaac Lab's manager-based API on GPU-accelerated MuJoCo Warp with minimal dependencies; reference velocity-tracking, motion-imitation and manipulation tasks, multi-GPU training; Apache-2.0.

name: MuJoCo
one_line: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact: open-source (Apache-2.0) general-purpose physics simulator widely used for robot RL and sim-to-real.

name: MuJoCo Menagerie
one_line: Collection of high-quality robot models for the MuJoCo physics engine, curated by Google DeepMind.

name: MuJoCo Playground
one_line: Open-source suite of GPU-accelerated MuJoCo (MJX/Warp) environments for classic control, locomotion, and non-prehensile/dexterous manipulation, with vision via batch rendering, PPO training and sim-to-real focus.

name: MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp)
one_line: GPU-accelerated MuJoCo built on NVIDIA Warp, jointly maintained by Google DeepMind and NVIDIA as part of Newton; usable via MJX, Isaac Lab and mjlab.

name: Newton
one_line: Open-source GPU-accelerated physics simulation engine built on NVIDIA Warp, targeting roboticists and simulation researchers; Apache-2.0.

name: robosuite: A Modular Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot Learning
one_line: Modular simulation framework and benchmark for robot learning; project site robosuite.ai.

name: so101_sim: MuJoCo sim environment for SO-100/SO-101 arms
one_line: MuJoCo simulation environment and task suite for SO-100/SO-101 arms, with an RL training notebook and a LeRobot-format wrapper for imitation learning.

name: A Comprehensive Survey on World Models for Embodied AI
one_line: Survey of embodied world models with a three-axis taxonomy (functionality, temporal modeling, spatial representation), cataloging datasets and metrics across robotics, driving and video prediction.

name: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models
one_line: Survey of RL for reasoning LLMs since DeepSeek-R1: foundational components, core problems, training resources and downstream applications; companion awesome list. LLM-focused, not robot policies.

name: A Survey on Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
one_line: TPAMI-accepted survey of efficient VLAs across three pillars: efficient model design (architectures, compression), efficient training, and efficient robot data collection.

name: Do World Models Make Better Robots? A Survey of Evaluation Benchmarks for Predictive Embodied Intelligence
one_line: Survey cataloging 160 embodied benchmarks (2017-2026); only 11 (7%) directly compare world models against VLA policies; proposes taxonomy, evaluation framework and four advantage-aware metrics.

name: Embodied Robot Manipulation in the Era of Foundation Models: Planning and Learning Perspectives
one_line: Survey organizing foundation-model-era manipulation into high-level task planning and low-level action modeling; re-architected core of the full survey arXiv:2510.10903 (v2 Aug 2026).

name: From Human Videos to Robot Manipulation: A Survey on Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning with Human-Centric Data
one_line: IJCAI 2026 survey of VLA learning from human videos, grouping methods into latent actions, predictive world models, explicit 2D supervision, and 3D reconstruction; covers embodiment gap and evaluation.

name: Large VLM-based Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation: A Survey
one_line: Survey of large-VLM-based VLAs for manipulation, split into monolithic vs hierarchical designs; covers integration with reinforcement learning, training-free optimization, human-video learning, and world models.

name: Pure Vision Language Action (VLA) Models: A Comprehensive Survey
one_line: Survey of 300+ VLA studies, categorized into autoregression-, diffusion-, reinforcement-based, hybrid and specialized paradigms, plus datasets, benchmarks and simulation platforms.

name: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
one_line: Position/survey recasting world models as agent-usable proxies: six types (dynamics, spatial, execution, memory, skill, reward/verification) across inference-time guidance, training-time optimization, and agent-proxy co-evolution.

name: Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Policies in Robotics: A Survey and State-Based Locomotion Reproduction
org: City University of Macau; Minzu University of China
one_line: Scoping review mapping 84 studies on RL for generative robot policies with a five-axis taxonomy; DPPO reproduction on D4RL Hopper gains +1261 mean return over BC initializations.

name: Robotic Foundation Models for Industrial Control: A Comprehensive Survey and Readiness Assessment Framework
one_line: Survey scoring 324 manipulation-capable robot foundation models against 149 industrial-readiness criteria (48,276 evaluations); finds industrial maturity limited and uneven.

name: Robotic Manipulation via Imitation Learning: Taxonomy, Evolution, Benchmark, and Challenges
one_line: Survey of imitation-learning manipulation policies: taxonomy, input formats, design choices, timeline of policy evolution, and benchmark comparisons, plus open challenges.

name: Self-evolving Embodied AI
one_line: Perspective paper proposing self-evolving embodied agents: memory self-updating, task self-switching, environment self-prediction, embodiment self-adaptation and model self-evolution for continual autonomous adaptation.

name: Towards a Unified Understanding of Robot Manipulation: A Comprehensive Survey
one_line: Broad manipulation survey: benchmarks, datasets, unified taxonomy of high-level planning and learning-based control (input modeling, latent learning, policy learning), plus data and generalization bottlenecks.

name: Vision Language Action Models in Robotic Manipulation: A Systematic Review
one_line: Systematic review of 102 VLA models, 26 datasets and 12 simulation platforms for manipulation, with a dataset taxonomy by semantic richness and multimodal alignment.

name: Vision-Language-Action in Robotics: A Survey of Datasets, Benchmarks, and Data Engines
one_line: TMLR-accepted data-centric VLA survey covering datasets (embodiment, modality, action space), benchmarks, and data engines (simulation, video reconstruction, task generation); argues data infrastructure, not architecture, limits progress.

name: Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review Towards Real-World Applications
one_line: Full-stack VLA survey (IEEE Access) covering architectures, modality processing, learning paradigms, robot platforms, data collection, datasets, augmentation and evaluation benchmarks for real-world deployment.

name: World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications
one_line: Broad world-model survey organized by architecture, methodology, reasoning strategy and application (robotics, RL, driving, video); traces PlaNet, Dreamer, MuZero, imagination-based planning and latent policy learning.

name: Cheng Chi: Robotics Beyond Algorithms [ETHZ Robot Learning 2026]
one_line: Guest lecture by Cheng Chi (Sunday Robotics) for ETH Zurich's Robot Learning course, posted on Oier Mees' channel; about robotics beyond algorithms, not policy improvement specifically.

name: Data-Driven Control (ICML 2026 workshop invited talk)
one_line: Sergey Levine's workshop invited talk on combining large-scale data-driven learning with RL's long-horizon optimization, spanning goal-directed image synthesis, dialogue, and robotic foundation models.

name: Post-Training for Robotics Foundation Models: From Pretrained Policies to Real-World Mastery (RSS 2026 Workshop + Challenge)
org: Fudan / WorldEngine; USC; Tsinghua; TRI; MIT; UC…
one_line: RSS 2026 workshop and two-phase bimanual post-training challenge (battery insertion, Tower of Hanoi, cap sealing) with expert, success/failure rollout and HIL data; $20k+ prizes; openpi baseline.

name: RoboPAD: Post-Training Adaptation of Robot Foundation Models (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop)
org: NeurIPS 2026 workshop; organizers from A*STAR, Inria…
one_line: NeurIPS 2026 workshop (Paris, Dec 12-13) on post-training robot foundation models: human feedback/intervention, policy optimization, world models, reasoning and memory, cross-embodiment adaptation, evaluation and safety.

name: RoboPapers (podcast)
one_line: Podcast hosted by Chris Paxton and Michael Cho that discusses robotics papers with the papers' authors.

name: RoboPapers Ep#103: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
one_line: Podcast with Marcel Torne, Anubha Mahajan, Abhijnya Bhat on FPL: natural-language preference axes train a language-conditioned reward model and reward-conditioned policy; +38 points over sparse-reward/binary-preference baselines.

name: RoboPapers Ep#38: Q Learning is Not Yet Scalable
one_line: Seohong Park explains why offline RL plateaus on long-horizon manipulation even with more data, identifying horizon as the scaling barrier and presenting horizon-reduction method SHARSA (arXiv 2506.04168).

name: RoboPapers Ep#58: RL-100: Performant Robotic Manipulation with Real-World Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Podcast with Kun Lei on RL-100: PPO-style objective inside diffusion denoising plus consistency distillation; 900/900 real-world successes across seven tasks, seven-hour public juicing deployment.

name: RoboPapers Ep#61: 1x World Model
one_line: Podcast with Daniel Ho (1X) on how NEO uses a video-pretrained world model as the policy backbone for zero-shot home manipulation instead of a data-hungry VLA.

name: RoboPapers Ep#86: RISE: Self-Improving Robot Policy with Compositional World Model
one_line: Jiazhi Yang interview on RISE (arXiv 2602.11075): policy improvement inside a compositional world model (dynamics + progress value) instead of real-world RL; +35% brick sorting, +45% backpack packing.

name: Training General Robots for Any Task: Physical Intelligence's Karol Hausman and Tobi Springenberg (Training Data podcast)
one_line: Hour-long interview on pi*0.6: moving from demonstrations to RL from real-world experience, citing 13-hour coffee-making runs and roughly 2x policy throughput.

name: A (Long) Peek into Reinforcement Learning
one_line: Primer on RL fundamentals: MDPs, Bellman equations, dynamic programming, Monte-Carlo, TD learning (SARSA, Q-learning, DQN), policy gradients (REINFORCE, actor-critic, A3C), evolution strategies, and an AlphaGo Zero case study.

name: Flow Matching Guide and Code
one_line: Self-contained guide to Flow Matching: mathematical foundations, design choices and extensions, with a PyTorch package and image/text generation examples. Background for flow-policy fine-tuning.

name: From Generalists to Specialists: A Case for Real-World RL in Robot Manipulation
org: USC Robotics and Autonomous Systems Center
one_line: USC blog arguing generalist VLAs should specialize via real-world RL; covers ReWiND learned rewards (5x in 1 hour), EXTRACT skill-based RL, and scalable multi-task evaluation.

name: LeRobot v0.6.0: Imagine, Evaluate, Improve
one_line: LeRobot release adding world-model policies (VLA-JEPA, LingBot-VA, FastWAM), reward models (Robometer, TOPReward), a lerobot-rollout CLI with DAgger-style human takeover corrections, and six new sim benchmarks.

name: Offline Reinforcement Learning: Tutorial, Review, and Perspectives on Open Problems
one_line: Tutorial and review of offline RL by Levine, Kumar, Tucker and Fu: learning from previously collected datasets without online data, its challenges, proposed solutions, applications and open problems.

name: Policy Gradient Algorithms
one_line: Long-form explainer deriving the policy gradient theorem and covering REINFORCE, actor-critic, A3C/A2C, DPG/DDPG, TRPO, PPO, ACER, ACKTR, SAC, TD3, SVPG and IMPALA.

name: SO-101 (LeRobot hardware documentation)
one_line: Official LeRobot guide to the SO-101 leader/follower arms: sourcing parts, Feetech motor ID setup, step-by-step assembly, and calibration before teleoperation and training.

name: Sporks of AGI: Why the Real Thing is better than the Next Best Thing
one_line: Levine essay arguing surrogate data (simulation, human video, handheld devices) are compromises that weaken robot foundation models; real-world robot data is indispensable for generalization.

name: Unfolding Robotics: The Open-Source Recipe for Teaching a Robot to Fold Your Clothes
one_line: Open recipe fine-tuning pi0/pi0.5 on bimanual OpenArm: 131 h teleop, SARM reward-based curation and weighted BC, DAgger, RTC; 90% shirt folding, curated data gave +50 points.

name: π*0.6 and RECAP: Teaching Robots to Learn From Their Mistakes
one_line: Third-party explainer of PI's RECAP: value-function advantages label actions positive/negative, VLA is conditioned on "positive" at deployment; reports 2.1-2.3x throughput, box assembly 65% to 90%.

name: π0 and π0-FAST: Vision-Language-Action Models for General Robot Control
one_line: Hugging Face post on the LeRobot port of Physical Intelligence's π0 (flow matching, 50Hz) and π0-FAST (DCT+BPE action tokens, 5x faster training), with fine-tuning commands.
